description: Queue an account health check now and return the run. If a check is already queued or running it is returned with alreadyInProgress true instead. Manual checks are limited to one every 10 minutes and wait a day after a check that left findings open (both 429 RATE_LIMITED with retryAfterSeconds), need more than 1,000 active subscribers and an email sent in the last 14 days (409 NOT_ELIGIBLE), and never send the report email. The check usually finishes within a minute; poll get_account_health until runInProgress is false. Requires sequences:write.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

name: run_account_health_check

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `run_account_health_check` MCP tool.

alreadyInProgress.description: True when an existing queued or running check was returned instead of a new one.
